description: With flowing drapery and wooden panelling, our local interior designer has created a baroque-inspired space. Sculpted fireplaces, an upstairs study, and even a bubble chair are among this apartment’s many surprises. A private balcony looks out on the neighbourhood’s magnificent architecture, and mirrors reflect the natural light from the windows. A few steps away from the Champs-Elysées it will only take a few minutes to admire the beautiful Arc de Triomphe.The space200 sqm1st bedroom (1 double bed)2nd bedroom (1 double bed)3rd bedroom (2 double beds)1st bathroom (shower/toilet)2nd bathroom (bath/toilet)Finest linens, towels and toiletriesFully equipped kitchenNespresso machine with capsulesOther things to noteTo ensure a smooth and secure arrival, you will need to complete a brief online check-in process before your stay. It's quick, easy, and helps us prepare for your visit!
